analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results during its earnings conference call on August 6, 2026. Standalone revenue grew 20% year-on-year to INR247.03 crores, while consolidated revenue rose 25% to INR269.23 crores, driven primarily by favorable mix changes and export growth. Management highlighted strong growth momentum from U.S. automotive OEM orders, though margins faced headwinds from higher freight costs, raw material volatility, and a muted domestic footwear segment. The company is expanding its existing PVC capacity by adding a new line expected to start production by February or March 2027, and continues to evaluate potential international and domestic greenfield expansions.

guidance.claim: The company expects sales growth and increased momentum from US automotive orders to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
guidance.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability. And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth between 8%-10% and export growth between 15%-20%.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the value growth will be much more than the volume growth.
guidance.quote: So, when we are saying volume, we are saying value growth also. So, obviously, the value growth will be much more than the volume growth because our export prices are much more higher.

guidance.claim: The company expects to maintain its profit margins around 25%-30% if growth momentum continues.
guidance.quote: So, we should look at somewhere around 25%-30% margin. It is very difficult to comment with exact figures.

guidance.claim: Management expects the increased export momentum to continue in the next 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

guidance.claim: Management targets a potential 15% growth in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the domestic footwear market experienced a degrowth during the quarter due to soaring raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So specifically, our footwear business, because you have to understand the price of raw material for footwear, not only the PVC prices, the sole prices increased drastically to -- it went up to almost like 2x, 3x last year -- sorry, in the last quarter. So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management highlighted that India's recently signed FTAs are expected to create very positive sentiments and make procurement from India more cost effective in European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects very strong growth to come from the export market.
demand_outlook.quote: So anywhere between 10% to 15% growth, we are not looking very strong growth in the domestic market. But yes, we are looking at a very strong growth in the export market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management sees more growth coming from the automotive side in both domestic and international markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, we are focusing more on the automotive sector. So, we see more growth coming from the automotive side, whether it's in the domestic market or in the international market.

demand_outlook.claim: The PU business remains muted and sales have not matured yet.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that European automotive industry is not growing and is seeing degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

capex_expansion.claim: The company ordered a new line for its current premises to add an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters, with production expected to start towards the end of the financial year between February and March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the capex planned for the financial year 2026-2027 is around INR50 crores.
The company has ordered a coating line and will install it in an existing facility instead of South India.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here. So, our capacity will increase. But we are not putting it in South India. We are putting it here.

capex_expansion.claim: The capital expenditure for the global location is estimated to be around INR 300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: But the CAPEX would be around INR 300 Cr for a global location.

capex_expansion.claim: If the capex is done on a global scale, it will cost INR300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: Once the decision for the South plant is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they will start the South plant with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.
capex_expansion.quote: And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that sustainable margins are expected to be 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses increased during the quarter due to a 4x increase in export shipping costs as well as higher traveling, legal, and professional service costs.
margins_costs.quote: No, it's mixed reasons. Some shipping cost, I already told you, shipping cost increased in this last quarter, 4x, okay, for the export and some traveling cost and other service cost, legal and professionals, etcetera, which we have incurred on that account. That expenses have increased in this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that dollar appreciation provided roughly a 10% natural hedge against raw material cost inflation.
margins_costs.quote: Right? If today I was selling material for US$8 and I was having realization of 85 to 86, so at 94 I was getting a 10% natural hedge. That’s okay, my raw material prices went up beyond that also.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for paste PVC went up significantly and reached highs in March.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of paste PVC have softened a little bit from the highs of March.
margins_costs.quote: And prices have also softened a little bit from the highs of March. It's softened a little bit.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses decreased in the quarter due to lower freight costs and controlled maintenance and repair costs.
margins_costs.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled and because of these two reasons our other income reduced

margins_costs.claim: Operating efficiency improved in the last quarter compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: So, our productivity where we measure the OE has also improved in the last quarter compared to our previous year and that has also contributed to the improvement in margins.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that imports are nearly one-third of total raw material cost.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Other income for the quarter included foreign exchange gain of around 50% with the remaining from treasury income.
margins_costs.quote: Yes. This quarter, other income has the major part of foreign exchange gain around 50% and remaining is our treasury income.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization for PVC is running between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported a total export sales of INR103.80 crores and total domestic sales of INR143.23 crores for the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Export general 30.24, export OEM 73.56, total exports is INR103.80 crores, auto OEM domestic 56.08, replacement, 36.52, footwear 41.16, furnishing 6.08 and other 3.38 and total domestic sale is 143.23.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the current installed PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters per month depending on the product mix.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix a lot, because some products have a faster line speed, some product has a slower line speed.

orders_capacity.claim: The company added more platforms on the Ford business and order volumes are increasing.
orders_capacity.quote: And our volume with Ford was very low. So, we have added more platforms on Ford business. The business has started increasing.

orders_capacity.claim: The new coating line capacity is expected to increase revenue by INR 120 crores to INR 150 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: So, revenue will increase by INR 120 Cr. – INR 150 Cr. And that much meter, we have given approximately figure.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU which was 2.56 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Short-term impacts on raw material costs take time to pass on to customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: Short-term, yes, maybe a month or so. Because it takes some time to pass on the price increase to the customers. Definitely, it impacts a little bit in the short-term.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that footwear business growth is affected by local competition and low price margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the new PVC expansion line will commence production between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The company's endeavor is to make it a preferred supplier for leading OEM and overseas markets, especially US and European regions.
management_commitments.quote: Further, our endeavor is to make the company a preferred supplier for the leading OEM and overseas markets, especially US and European regions.

management_commitments.claim: The new coating line ordered for the existing location is expected to be completed by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects increased export momentum to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
